Not a lot of offensive highlights to report so far. Devontez Walker has had a few chunk plays.

Tyler Loop is still kicking well. He’s 6/6 so far, including two FGs from 40+. This would be his third straight “live” session without a miss.

DK Metcalf and Michael Pittman Jr. have injuries, Aaron Rodgers said. 

Rodgers pointed out how guys like Germie Bernard and Brandon Smith have stepped up.

Rodgers with a ton of praise for Smith, who he says is in much better shape than he was when both were on the Jets.

Aaron Rodgers says Germie Bernard is a 'great kid,' but he is looking to see Bernard continue to completely grasp the playbook and play as fast as possible.

"He's so sudden. He's got phenomenal hands...we just need him to be super confident and play as fast as he can."

Aaron Rodgers says he dropped knowledge on the DBs in practice to try and help guys.

There was one instance where he discussed with Asante Samuel Jr. on how fade balls would be thrown on the goal line when teams are under center vs. in the shotgun.

That knowledge is important.

Notably, Aaron Rodgers just said he views joint practices as a 'waste of a day.'  

"Teams don't run anything anymore. Sometimes, they'd show you real things they'd work on. But as it went on, it turned into fights. I think those are waste of a day."
